note: Gu worms referenced by the game. `diet` and `feedDays` drive the upkeep system; `canonical: true` means the Gu can never be lost to upkeep or refinement failure (§5.2, §5.5). `stonesPerFeed` is the fallback cost when the diet item is not in inventory.

gu.name: Spring Autumn Cicada
effects: Dormant for almost all of the game. Its two uses are fixed events, not an ability on a cooldown.
gu.notes: Pressure on the Liquor worm at chapter 19 and the single rewind at 195-196. Never exposed as a player-triggered ability.

gu.name: Hope Gu
effects: Opens the aperture at the awakening ceremony and reveals aptitude.
gu.notes: Clan property, used on the student and then gone. Never enters the player's inventory.

gu.name: Moonlight Gu
effects: Moonblade: a ranged crescent that costs primeval essence on every use.
gu.notes: The Gu Yue clan's signature, and the reason the clan controls its breeding method. The diet is the first upkeep the player ever pays.

gu.name: Liquor worm
effects: Refines primeval essence by a small stage while it is fed.
gu.notes: Stops refining Rank two essence from chapter 20 onward. Its appetite is the reason the economy bites in Act I.

gu.name: Little Light Gu
effects: Supports Moonlight Gu: the Moonblade lands harder.
gu.notes: Two of them by the later half of Act II.

gu.name: White Boar Gu
effects: Bodily strength, permanently retained as the Gu is nourished.
Stops granting strength once its ceiling is reached (ch 79).
gu.notes: From the first Earth Treasury Flower.

gu.name: Jade Skin Gu
effects: Guard: roughly three seconds, about 75% of incoming damage turned aside.
gu.notes: From the second Earth Treasury Flower, beyond the boulder.

gu.name: White Jade Gu
effects: Guard: roughly six seconds, about 90% of incoming damage turned aside.
gu.notes: The snowy tusk from the boar king improves the recipe. Canonical, so the refinement cannot fail outright — only cost time and stones.

gu.name: Moonglow Gu
effects: Rank two ranged attack. Replaces the Moonblade as the main line of damage.
gu.notes: The scripted first failure of this refinement stays (§5.5). The second attempt succeeds.

gu.name: Four Flavours Liquor worm
effects: Refines Rank two essence by a small stage.
gu.notes: Needs a second Liquor worm as material. The upkeep is deliberately expensive; it is meant to hurt.

gu.name: Stealth Scales Gu
effects: Conceal: ordinary wolves lose track of the player.
gu.notes: Central to surviving the wolf tide as an observer rather than a participant.

gu.name: Earth Communication Ear Grass
effects: Listen: concealed danger is marked briefly through terrain.
gu.notes: Pairs with Stealth Scales for the tide sequence.

gu.name: Nine Leaf Vitality Grass
effects: Stores vitality leaves; a leaf restores vitality on use.
Yields leaves on a cycle — the basis of the leaf-selling loop.
gu.notes: The only healing in the game, and it is gone before chapter 200.

gu.name: Water Shield Gu
effects: Recorded acquisition. White Jade stays equipped; this is inventory, not a new button.
gu.notes: Kept in the ledger so chapter 138 is not silently skipped.

gu.name: Sky Canopy Gu
effects: Active defence. Replaces White Jade as the guard.
gu.notes: An elder's equipment. The upkeep jump is the point of becoming an elder.

gu.name: Thunderwings Gu
effects: Short flight, represented as a movement burst with an essence cost.
gu.notes: Survives to chapter 200 and matters for the escape.

gu.name: Blood Moon Gu
effects: A red crescent with a delayed second hit.
gu.notes: Chosen partly because its diet does not chain Fang Yuan to clan supplies once he leaves.

gu.name: Chainsaw Golden Centipede
effects: Close-range weapon with a high essence cost per swing.

gu.name: Tusita Flower
effects: Storage. Holds the supplies Fang Yuan leaves the mountain with.
gu.notes: Storage Gu, so it is also the in-fiction reason a Legacy export can list carried items.

gu.name: Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus
effects: Taken from the deep inheritance. Narrative object rather than an ability.

gu.name: Stone Aperture Gu
effects: Expended. Rank three peak reached and the chance of further advancement spent.
gu.notes: A cost, not a gain. The ledger has to say so plainly.

gu.name: Blood Skull Gu
effects: Fixed narrative use in the blood curtain. No victim-scoring mechanic of any kind.
gu.notes: Deliberately not a system. §4.4 applies: the decision is on screen, the act is cut away from.

gu.name: Yang Gu
effects: Retained by Fang Yuan. The lever over Bai Ning Bing that the sequel inherits.
gu.notes: Exported in the Legacy file as the thread `bai.yang-leverage`.

gu.name: Yin Gu
effects: Restores Bai Ning Bing's arm and completes the transformation.
gu.notes: Given away, not kept. Bai's one-arm model is replaced from this beat onward.

gu.name: Mudskin Toad Gu
effects: Minor protection. Bought at the caravan mostly as cover for the rest of the transaction.

gu.name: Bamboo Gentleman
effects: Held by the clan at the inquiry. Stays green while the speaker is telling the truth.
gu.notes: Never the player's. The Cicada's pressure is what keeps it green, and that is a fixed outcome.

gu.name: Photo-audio Gu
effects: Powers the cave's image wall until it is exhausted.
gu.notes: Once exhausted the wall is ordinary stone. The gallery replay is a player convenience, not a fiction.

gu.name: Blood Essence Gu
effects: Refinement material for Blood Moon Gu.

gu.name: Black Boar Gu
effects: Strength, retained after the Gu itself is traded away.

optionalGu.name: Dull Sight Gu
effects: Witnesses recall one detail less. Cheapens evidence cleanup in the extortion and Jia Jin Sheng arcs.
optionalGu.notes: Sidegrade. Its refinement can fail outright; nothing canonical depends on it.

optionalGu.name: Quiet Step Gu
effects: Detection radius reduced while walking. Helps the stealth template, never required by it.

optionalGu.name: Ledger Moth
effects: Daily income and expense lines are itemised instead of summarised in the stone ledger.
optionalGu.notes: A convenience the fiction can justify. Sidegrade.

optionalGu.name: Cold Hearth Gu
effects: Cold regions drain vitality more slowly. Eases the winter crossing.
optionalGu.notes: Sidegrade. The winter crossing is survivable without it.

items.name: Green Bamboo Wine
items.note: Price as stated in the source text. Everything else in the economy is balanced around figures like this one.

items.name: Moon orchid petals
items.note: Gathered near the awakening river, or bought.

items.name: Snowy tusk
items.note: From the boar king. Refinement ingredient, never sold.

items.name: Purple-gold fossil
items.note: The cover story for the Liquor worm. Its real value is as evidence, not as a Gu.

items.name: Vitality leaf
items.note: Sale price through Jiang Ya. The leaf loop is the player's most reliable income in Act III.
